narr: Thunderstorms developed ahead of an approaching cold front during the afternoon hours on Sunday (6/29) across central and east-central Wisconsin. The strongest storms produced damaging winds, hail up to half dollar size, and flash flooding as 2 to 3 inches of rain fell across the area.
ev: Rainfall amounts of 2 to 3 inches in a short time caused US Highway 45 to close at the intersection of County Road O south of Clintonville due to flash flooding. The time of this report is an estimate based on radar data.

Rainfall amounts of 2 to 3 inches in a short time caused caused a section of County Road F southeast of Bonduel to close due to flash flooding on the roadway. The time of this report is an estimate based on radar data.
lsr: Minor street flooding reported in Clintonville. Via social media.
